title: Muji optimized
description: A high-performance modpack optimized for smooth, lag-free Minecraft gameplay.
body: A lightweight, high-performance Minecraft modpack designed to run smoothly on most systems. This pack optimizes gameplay with carefully selected mods that enhance FPS, reduce lag, and improve overall stability, while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact. Perfect for players who want fast, responsive gameplay without sacrificing fun or customization.
